source.@value:
rule "pve_identify_by_process"
when
  has_field("message") AND (
    contains(to_string($message.message), "pvedaemon[") OR
    contains(to_string($message.message), "pvescheduler[") OR
    contains(to_string($message.message), "qmeventd[") OR
    contains(to_string($message.message), "pveproxy[") OR
    contains(to_string($message.message), "pvestatd:") OR
    contains(to_string($message.message), "pvestatd[") OR
    contains(to_string($message.message), "pve-firewall[") OR
    contains(to_string($message.message), "pve-ha-lrm[") OR
    contains(to_string($message.message), "pve-ha-crm[") OR
    contains(to_string($message.message), "pmxcfs[") OR
    contains(to_string($message.message), "pve-zsync[") OR
    contains(to_string($message.message), "pve-cluster[")
  )
then
  set_field("app", "pve");
  let g = grok(pattern: "\\b(?<pve_app>pvedaemon|pvescheduler|qmeventd|pveproxy|pvestatd|pve-firewall|pve-ha-lrm|pve-ha-crm|pmxcfs|pve-zsync|pve-cluster)(?:\\[|:)", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true);
  set_fields(g);
end

rule "pve_replication_legacy"
when
  to_string($message.pve_event, "") == "replication_error"
then
  set_field("pve_RepTaskID", to_string($message.VMID, "") + "-" + to_string($message.replication_job_idx, ""));
  set_field("pve_RepTaskError", to_string($message.replication_error, ""));
end

rule "pve_parse_upid_result"
when
  has_field("upid_user") AND
  contains(to_string($message.message, ""), "end task UPID:")
then
  let g = grok(pattern: ":[^:]+: %{GREEDYDATA:result}$", value: to_string($message.message, ""), only_named_captures: true);
  set_fields(g);
end

rule "pve_parse_lxc_cgroup"
when
  to_string($message.app) == "pve" AND
  contains(to_string($message.message), "/lxc/")
then
  let g = grok(pattern: "/lxc/%{NONNEGINT:VMID:int}", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true);
  set_fields(g);
end

rule "pve_parse_vm_n"
when
  to_string($message.app) == "pve" AND
  contains(to_string($message.message), "VM ")
then
  let g = grok(pattern: "\\bVM %{NONNEGINT:VMID:int} ", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true);
  set_fields(g);
end

rule "pve_lookup_vmname"
when
  to_string($message.app) == "pve" AND
  has_field("VMID")
then
  set_field("VMNAME", lookup_value("getpvevmlist", to_string($message.VMID)));
end

pipeline "PVE Parsing"
stage 0 match either
    rule "pve_identify_by_process"
    rule "pve_identify_by_source"
stage 1 match either
    rule "pve_parse_upid"
    rule "pve_parse_vm_n"
    rule "pve_parse_backup_starting"
    rule "pve_parse_backup_finished"
    rule "pve_parse_backup_error"
    rule "pve_parse_backup_job_vmids"
    rule "pve_parse_vncproxy"
    rule "pve_parse_qmeventd"
    rule "pve_parse_replication_error"
    rule "pve_parse_lxc_cgroup"
    rule "pve_parse_oom"
    rule "pve_parse_pvedaemon_auth"
    rule "pve_parse_pveproxy_worker"
    rule "pve_parse_pvestatd_status"
    rule "pve_parse_pvestatd_error"
stage 2 match either
    rule "pve_lookup_vmname"
    rule "pve_legacy_user_realm_pid"
    rule "pve_parse_upid_result"
    rule "pve_replication_legacy"
end

rule "pve_identify_by_source"
when
  has_field("source") AND (
    starts_with(to_string($message.source, ""), "host-") OR
    starts_with(to_string($message.source, ""), "pc-pve") OR
    contains(to_string($message.source, ""), "-pve")
  )
then
  set_field("app", "pve");
end
